summary: Comprehensive testing of Menu System feature completed. All 16 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend menu display and admin CRUD operations working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Menu API properly implements soft-delete pattern (is_deleted flag)
Public menu correctly filters out unavailable items (is_available=false)
Admin menu tab shows all items including unavailable ones with 'Utilgjengelig' badge
Inline edit form in admin works correctly with category dropdown, name, price, description fields
Menu seeding is idempotent - only seeds if no items exist
All data-testid attributes properly implemented for testing
seed_data_creation: 10 default menu items seeded on startup (Bakst: 4, Varm mat: 1, Drikke: 4, Spesielt: 1)
